name: psi4-parser
description: Turn scientific requirements into checked Psi4 calculation plans and input bundles; build, validate, format, or convert inputs with Python.

interface.longDescription: Describe molecular inputs, allowed models, geometry dependencies, and requested quantities. Propose a plan, check its coverage and scientific/input contracts, and export Psi4 input with verification records. Compose supported operations into new workflows using Python or compact CLI/MCP interfaces. The agent chooses scientific requirements; verification checks their implementation. Execution and result interpretation are separate.
interface.defaultPrompt: Plan my Psi4 calculations from independent scientific requirements, inspect matching capability evidence, and save a checked input bundle.
